name: isotask
description: Notes as tasks: due dates, recurrence, priorities, and feed and calendar views built on Bases.
author: Diego Pasquali

scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:fast && tsx e2e/generate-fixtures.mts && wdio run wdio.conf.mts
scripts.test:e2e:verbose: pnpm build:fast && E2E_VERBOSE=1 tsx e2e/generate-fixtures.mts && E2E_VERBOSE=1 wdio run wdio.conf.mts
scripts.shots:docs: pnpm build:fast && tsx e2e/generate-docs-fixtures.mts && E2E_DOCS_SHOTS=1 wdio run wdio.conf.mts --spec docs-screenshots && tsx e2e/frame-docs-shots.mts && tsx e2e/compose-hero.mts
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json package.json
